info.title: kickNX
info.author: j2k
info.description: Kick streaming client for Nintendo Switch
info.details: kickNX is an independent Kick client built specifically for the Nintendo Switch. It brings livestream viewing, category discovery, search, and integrated chat interaction to handheld, tabletop, and docked play.

changelog:
v0.4.0
Initial release of kickNX for Nintendo Switch.

Highlights
- Native Kick livestream playback powered by mpv and FFmpeg
- Controller-first and touch-friendly interface built on Borealis
- Stream browsing by top categories, featured channels, and live search
- Integrated live chat with sub emotes and channel badges
- Hardware, Hybrid, and Software decoder switching
- Portrait mode support for vertical handheld viewing
- Standalone configuration and cache storage under /switch/kickNX
